race.comment: MACCA'S ANGEL (6) has had a few chances but is knocking on the door, running on well to miss by a head here last time out. Drawn wide but turns around quickly and should take plenty of holding out. KISS THE KING (5) might have a bit more upside and did run a career best last start at Bendigo last time in potentially a stronger maiden, running on for third. Back to synthetic is fine and she'll go close. ALL TOO SINGLE (1) ran well enough first up here when settling a long way back, working home to grab sixth. Fitter for that and can settle much closer up in trip. OLIVE ROAD (7) was fair fresh at Bendigo but can do better on this surface having shown good ability last time in. COURTING (13) was in the market on debut but didn't handle the going, look for a much better run.
